statBlock.name: Needle Blight
statBlock.description: A walking thicket that shoots needles. When it senses danger, it sends pollen on the wind to alert nearby needle blights.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. The blight is blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 9.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (2d4 + 1) piercing damage.
Needles. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d6 + 1) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Vine Blight
statBlock.description: A tangle of creeping vines that hides in the undergrowth and turns the surrounding plants against its prey.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. The blight is blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 10.
sections.Traits: False Appearance. A motionless vine blight looks just like a tangle of vines.
sections.Actions:
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller target is also Grappled (escape DC 12) and Restrained for the duration of the grapple. While that grapple lasts, the blight cannot use Constrict on another target.
Entangling Plants (Recharge 5-6). Roots and vines fill a 15-ft. radius centered on the blight. They wither after 1 minute. Until then, the area is difficult terrain for creatures other than plants. When the plants appear, each creature the blight chooses in the area makes a DC 12 Strength save. On a failure, it is Restrained. As an action, a creature can make a DC 12 Strength check to free itself or an entangled creature within reach.

statBlock.name: Sahuagin Baron
statBlock.description: A four-armed sahuagin that rules an undersea domain, using sharks to support its raids.

sections.Traits:
Blood Frenzy. It has advantage on melee attack rolls against creatures below their hit point maximum.
Limited Amphibiousness. It breathes air and water. Without submerging at least once every 4 hours, it begins to suffocate.
Shark Telepathy. It can give magical telepathic commands to any shark within 120 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two attacks with Claws or Trident.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Trident. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) when wielded in two hands in melee.

statBlock.name: Sahuagin Priestess
statBlock.description: A cleric of the shark god Sekolah who can command sharks and call up a spectral trident.

sections.Traits:
Blood Frenzy. It has advantage on melee attack rolls against creatures below their hit point maximum.
Limited Amphibiousness. It breathes air and water. Without submerging at least once every 4 hours, it begins to suffocate.
Shark Telepathy. It can give magical telepathic commands to any shark within 120 ft.
sections.Spellcasting:
6th-level cleric spellcasting. Wisdom, spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks.
At will. Guidance, Thaumaturgy.
1st level (4 slots). Bless, Detect Magic, Guiding Bolt.
2nd level (3 slots). Hold Person, Spiritual Weapon (trident).
3rd level (3 slots). Mass Healing Word, Tongues.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Quaggoth
statBlock.description: A pale Underdark climber that fights with its claws and grows more dangerous when wounded.

sections.Defenses: Immune to poison damage and the Poisoned condition.
sections.Traits: Wounded Fury. At 10 HP or fewer, it has advantage on attack rolls. Each melee attack that hits deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 256. Passive Perception follows the official errata.

statBlock.name: Quaggoth Thonot
statBlock.description: A quaggoth that becomes the keeper of tribal lore after developing psionic powers.

sections.Defenses: Immune to poison damage and the Poisoned condition.
sections.Traits: Wounded Fury. At 10 HP or fewer, it has advantage on attack rolls. Each melee attack that hits deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Psionics. Wisdom, spell save DC 11. These spells require no components.
At will. Feather Fall, Mage Hand (invisible hand).
1/day each. Cure Wounds, Enlarge/Reduce, Heat Metal.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 256. The printed thonot variant retains quaggoth statistics except for the listed challenge rating, XP, and psionics. Passive Perception follows the base quaggoth errata.

statBlock.name: Troglodyte
statBlock.description: An Underdark hunter that blends into cave walls and leaves a sharp, clinging stench.

sections.Traits:
Chameleon Skin. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
Stench. When a creature other than a troglodyte starts its turn within 5 ft., it makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it is Poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to the Stench of every troglodyte for 1 hour.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
